theorem lg_target (x : ENNReal) (y : ℝ) : x ^ y = (↑y * x.log).exp := by
  cases x
  case some x' =>
    have h1 : x'.log = (x').log := rfl
    have h2 : ↑y * x'.log = (↑y * x'.log) := rfl
    have h3 : exp(↑y * x'.log) = (↑y * x'.log).exp := rfl
    rw [h3]
    rw [ENNReal.pow_def]
    exact rfl
  case none =>
    have h4 : ENNReal.ofReal y * ENNReal.ofReal 0 = 0 := by rw [mul_zero]
    have h5 : (ENNReal.ofReal y * ENNReal.ofReal 0).exp = 0 := by rw [h4, exp_zero]
    have h6 : ENNReal.ofReal 0 ^ y = 0 := by rw [pow_zero]
    rw [h6]
    exact h5
